content.trans: 您真的承认她可能忘记了自己的姐姐的生日。

content.text: Example 3.
content.trans: Example 3. (注释)

content.text: Both philosophers conceded that their philosophies have some errors.
content.trans: 两人都承认他们的哲学有一些错误。

content.text: Okay, so you have to concede that.
content.trans: 好的，你必须承认。

content.text: Basically, you have to agree that this one point in my argument is true.
content.trans: 基本来说，你必须同意这个我的论点是正确的。

content.text: Maybe you're arguing many different points with somebody, but you tell them well, you
content.trans: 你可能在和某人争论许多不同的观点，但你告诉他很好，你。

content.text: have to concede that the earth is round.
content.trans: 有资格承认地球是圆的。

content.text: Okay, so that part I can't argue with.
content.trans: 好的，那么这部分我不太清楚。

content.text: It's really true.
content.trans: 是的，是真的。

content.text: Okay, very good.
content.trans: 好的，很好。

content.text: So concede.
content.trans: 所以，接受。

content.text: Now at the end of the dialogue, the student accused the professor of being in the pocket
content.trans: 现在对话的末尾，学生指控教授是在口袋里。

content.text: of the oil lobby.

content.text: Okay, so he's in the pocket of...

content.text: To be in the pocket of.

content.text: Alright, so if I have somebody in my pocket, what does that mean?
content.trans: 好的，如果我口袋里有人，那意味着什么？

content.text: It means basically you're bribing them.
content.trans: 它意味着基本上你是在贿赂他们。

content.text: Okay, so maybe I have the senator in my pocket.
content.trans: 好的，也许我口袋里有议员。

content.text: Okay, so obviously you're paying the senator to do what you want.
content.trans: 好的，所以很明显，你正在要求这个议员做你想做的事情。

content.text: Okay, very good.
content.trans: 好的，很好。

content.text: So it's another way, it's a very informal way of saying I'm bribing somebody or that
content.trans: 所以，这又是一个方式，这是一种非常正式的表达，我正在贿赂某人或说。

content.text: person is being bribed.
content.trans: 一个人在被贿赂。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So why don't we move to our final phrase?
content.trans: 所以，我们为什么不转到我们的结尾呢？

content.text: And the students was talking about the professors so called findings.
content.trans: 和学生们讨论的是被称作教授发现的论文。

content.text: Okay, so you're so called findings.
content.trans: 好的，您被称作发现。

content.text: So called.
content.trans: 所以称为。

content.text: So this word so called.
content.trans: 所以这个叫做的字。

content.text: You use this word when you want to take away from the importance of an idea.
content.trans: 您使用这个词是为了从一个想法中去除其重要性。

content.text: Alright, so I use it before a noun, right?
content.trans: 是的，所以我用它之前是一个名词吗？

content.text: So for example, my so-called friends.
content.trans: 所以，例如，我的所谓的朋友。

content.text: Okay, so these friends are not really your friends maybe.
content.trans: 好的，这些朋友不是你的朋友，可能。

content.text: So yeah, they're friends in name, but they don't act like friends.
content.trans: 所以啊，他们有朋友的名号，但他们在行动上却不像朋友。

content.text: Okay, so you can say my so-called job.
content.trans: 好的，你可以这么说我的所谓的职位。

content.text: Okay, so maybe you kind of go to work but do nothing all day.
content.trans: 好的，也许你有点上班，但整天无所事事。

content.text: Right, or maybe you don't even really like what you do.
content.trans: 是的，或者你可能根本不喜欢自己做的事情。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 右。

content.text: So my so-called job, my so-called friends, or maybe my so-called teacher.
content.trans: 所以，我所谓的“工作”，所谓的朋友，或者也许是我所谓的老师。

content.text: Okay, so this is a bad teacher.
content.trans: 好的，这是个不好的老师。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So we use it a lot with many different nouns, right?
content.trans: 所以我们经常用它与许多不同的名词一起使用吗？

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So that's our last phrase for Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 所以，这就是Fluency Builder的最后一个短语。

content.text: Now, I think it will help us to understand these words and phrases a little bit better
content.trans: 现在，我认为这将有助于我们更好地理解这些词汇和短语。

content.text: to hear them again in context.
content.trans: 在语境中再次听到他们。

content.text: And therefore, global warming is the greatest deception of the early 21st century.
content.trans: 因此，全球变暖是新世纪早期最大的欺骗。

content.text: Questions?
content.trans: 问题？

content.text: Uh, yeah.
content.trans: 嗯，对。

content.text: In the lecture, you said there's more evidence in the scientific record supporting global
content.trans: 在讲座中，你提到有更多证据支持全球科学记录中的证据。

content.text: cooling.
content.trans: 冷却。 (Shuowen yi)

content.text: Well, yes.
content.trans: 是的，很好。

content.text: Essentially, the historical record supports a theory of climate cycles.
content.trans: 基本来说，历史记录支持气候循环理论。

content.text: Warming and cooling are cooperating processes in the planetary ecosystem.
content.trans: 暖化和冷却是行星生态系统中的协同过程。

content.text: If that's true, and the planet is getting cooler, what explains the rapid melting of the
content.trans: 如果这是真的，那么地球的温度会降低，那么为什么冰川在快速融化？

content.text: polar ice caps and the dramatic rise in the global average temperatures?
content.trans: 极地冰盖和全球平均气温的急剧上升？

content.text: But our global temperatures rising.
content.trans: 但是我们的全球气温正在上升。

content.text: If you look at the data from 1975, you'll-
content.trans: 如果你看看从1975年开始的数据，你就会发现：

content.text: You'll be misled.
content.trans: 您将被误导。

content.text: If you were serious, you would look at the record starting in the 1880s.
content.trans: 如果你认真，你就会从20世纪初开始记录。

content.text: Then you would see how dramatically the Earth's temperature has changed.
content.trans: 那么，你就会看到地球温度变化有多么惊人。

content.text: Young lady, I beg to differ.
content.trans: 小姐，我不同意。

content.text: Look, the point of the lecture was to emphasize that there's evidence for both sides.
content.trans: 请看，讲座的目的是强调双方都有证据。

content.text: And I'm putting forth the argument that there's greater evidence in support of the global
content.trans: 而且我提出了一种论点，认为全球的证据比个人证据更有力。

content.text: cooling hypothesis.
content.trans: 冷却假设。

content.text: Look, it's an indisputable fact that the public is being manipulated and scared into believing
content.trans: 请看，这是一个无可争议的事实，公众被操纵和恐吓地相信。

content.text: that there's some kind of climate crisis.
content.trans: 那存在某种气候危机。

content.text: This scaremongering is done quite simply for political reasons.
content.trans: 这个冒充是出于政治目的。

content.text: But even without the uncomfortable reality that greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide contribute
content.trans: 但是，即使没有温室气体如二氧化碳这样的不舒适的现实。

content.text: to global warming, isn't the topic appropriate for politicians to discuss?
content.trans: 是的，这个问题很有趣。在讨论全球变暖的问题时，政治家们是否合适谈论呢？

content.text: Not if they want to use your tax dollars and mine to fund completely unnecessary initiatives.
content.trans: 如果他们想使用你的税收资金并用来资助完全不必要的项目。

content.text: Yeah, like conservation, protecting endangered species, and investing in renewable energy.
content.trans: 是的，就像保护濒危物种，保护濒危物种，以及投资于可再生能源。

content.text: At the very least, you have to concede that this debate has the potential to end our
content.trans: 在最起码的情况下，你必须承认这场辩论有可能结束我们的。

content.text: dependence on foreign oil.
content.trans: 依赖于外国石油。

content.text: Buying oil supports autocratic countries that use these revenues to devastating ends.
content.trans: 购买石油支持那些依赖这些收入进行毁灭性活动的独裁国家。

content.text: I've never been so disrespected in all of my days.
content.trans: 我从没被如此侮辱过。

content.text: I'm a professor, a scientist, and a researcher of high regard.
content.trans: 我是教授、科学家和研究专家。

content.text: Yeah, and the duplicitous one at that.
content.trans: 是的，那个双面的。

content.text: Everyone knows you're in the pocket of the oil lobby.
content.trans: 每个人都知道你是在石油利益集团的圈子里。

content.text: Why should we trust your so-called findings more than tobacco institute studies, which say
content.trans: 为什么我们应该更信任您所谓的发现，而不是烟草研究所的研究，即：

content.text: smoking doesn't harm health?
content.trans: 吸烟对健康没有害处？

content.text: You're full of it.
content.trans: 您满腔热情。

content.text: Some people just cannot handle civil debate.
content.trans: 有些人根本就无法处理公民辩论。

content.text: All right, very good.
content.trans: 好的，很好。

content.text: So, interesting ways of putting forth arguments, and well, it's an interesting topic and very
content.trans: 所以，有趣的方式提出论点，以及……很好，这是一个有趣的主题和非常有意思的话题。

content.text: controversial, right?
content.trans: 在中文中，"controversial, right?" 可以翻译为：

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: But what I noticed in this dialogue is that the student was pretty assertive in putting
content.trans: 但是，在这次对话中，我发现学生非常积极地在表达。

content.text: forth her argument in standing up to the teacher.
content.trans: 在她坚持反抗老师的观点。

content.text: Right, she argued with the teacher a lot.
content.trans: 正确，她与老师争论很多。

content.text: And this is interesting because it's a very cultural aspect, I think, right?
content.trans: 而且，这也是一个非常文化的角度，我认为是正确的。

content.text: Yeah, in North American universities, there is this idea that it's really important to
content.trans: 是的，在美国的大学里，有一个想法说它真的很重要。

content.text: think critically and to argue against different ideas and to really speak up when you don't
content.trans: 思考冷静地和反驳不同的观点，当您不赞同时，真正地说出您的意见。

content.text: agree with something.
content.trans: 同意某事。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: So, basically, there's this culture of questioning, not only what you're being taught, but
content.trans: 因此，基本上，有这种质疑的文化，不仅是在你被教导的方面，而且在你所接受的知识和经验中。

content.text: you can also question the teacher.
content.trans: 你还可以质疑老师。

content.text: You don't actually have to believe everything that the teacher is saying.
content.trans: 您不需要真的相信老师在说的一切。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: I think this situation is really interesting.
content.trans: 我认为这种情况真的很有趣。

content.text: You always go to these lectures, and there's always a question and answer period at the
content.trans: 你总是去这些讲座，而且在每节课的最后都会有一个问答环节。

content.text: end of the lectures.
content.trans: 结束课程。

content.text: And I think that there's this group of academically-minded people who feel like it's really cool
content.trans: 我认为，有学术头脑的人们觉得这真的很酷。

content.text: to ask these really difficult questions and engage in arguments with the props.
content.trans: 要问这些问题真的很困难，与道具进行辩论。

content.text: Yeah, yeah, that's really true.
content.trans: 是的，是的，那真是真的。

content.text: But actually, she used a lot of polite language and a lot of polite ways of actually arguing
content.trans: 但是实际上，她使用了很多礼貌的语言和实际的辩论技巧。

content.text: with the professor.
content.trans: 给教授。

content.text: Yeah, until the last point when she said you're full of it.
content.trans: 是的，直到她最后说你满腹经纶。

content.text: Yeah, you're full of it.
content.trans: 是的，你满腹经纶。

content.text: You're full of it.
content.trans: 您满腹经纶。

content.text: So, what she's saying here?
content.trans: 所以，她在这里怎么说？

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: She's basically saying that you're full of shit.
content.trans: 她基本上是在说你满脑子都是屎。

content.text: Work out.
content.trans: 工作。

content.text: So, yeah, you wouldn't really say that.
content.trans: 所以，对了，你不会说那句话的。

content.text: So, to be a little bit less rude, you would just say you're full of it.
content.trans: 所以，稍微少一点粗鲁点，你可以说你吃得太多了。

content.text: Yeah, but that is one step too far.
content.trans: 是的，但这是一步太远了。

content.text: I think this would be considered a little bit rude in the university.
content.trans: 我认为这在大学里可能会被视为有点粗鲁。

content.text: Yeah, for a professor, yeah.
content.trans: 是的，对于教授来说，对。

content.text: But I guess if you don't believe what your friend is telling you or maybe he's exaggerating,
content.trans: 但是，我猜如果你不相信你的朋友在说些什么或者他可能夸大了，

content.text: you can say, oh, you're full of it.
content.trans: 你可以这么说，你满腹经纶。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: So, great argumentative language here in this dialogue.
content.trans: 所以，在这个对话中，这里就有很强的辩论语言。

content.text: But we want to give you an opportunity to try out some of this language.
content.trans: 但是，我们希望您有机会试用一些这语言。

content.trans: 所以，请访问我们的网站：英语pod.com。

content.text: We are there to answer any questions or doubts.
content.trans: 我们在这里来回答任何问题或疑虑。

content.text: And we'll see you guys there.
